plain.li: You keep a good house here, mostly.
I've been walking a long time, longer than you'd believe.
Don't trouble yourself over me, I sleep very little.
Your grandmother would have liked this place, {OTHER_nameDef}.
People show what they are to strangers, I find.
I'll remember this, one way or another.
Every door I knock on tells me something.
[gate] It's a fine night to sleep under the sky, as it happens.
[gate] The wall keeps the wind off, and that's something.
[animals] Your beasts are hungry, did you know that?
[animals] An animal remembers who fed it, and so do I.
[walking] You know what I am, I think, so let's not pretend at supper.
[walking] Ask me what you want to ask, {OTHER_nameDef}, while I'm here.
[storm] The rain will hold off until I've gone.
[storm] Listen, that's not thunder yet, but it will be.
[harvest] Your fields have two more weeks before the frost, not three.
[harvest] The barley by the wall is ready, whatever your farmer says.
[hunt] There are three deer in the trees to the north, and one is lame.
[hunt] Your hunters walk too loudly, tell them that from me.
[healing] That cough of yours will clear by morning, {OTHER_nameDef}.
[healing] Boil your water a little longer, all of you.
[war] Your east wall is the weak one, and they'll know it too.
[war] I've stood in worse places than this, and come out of them.
[craft] Whoever made that blade knew what they were about.
[craft] Your forge runs too cold, that's why the iron cracks.
[way] The road east is clear, and the one north isn't.
[way] I know the way to everywhere, more or less.
[dead] Your dead are resting well, I looked in on them.
[dead] I knew someone buried here, a long time ago.
[night] You dreamed of water last night, {OTHER_nameDef}, didn't you.
[night] The moon will be full in two nights, watch for it.
[hearth] A house is its fire, and yours burns well.
[hearth] Never eat while a guest goes hungry, my mother said.
[wild] The old oak on the ridge is older than your whole colony.
[wild] Leave the last of the berries for the birds this year.
[waters] Your well is sweet, and it will stay sweet if you're kind to it.
[waters] The river has been asking after you.
[machine] Your batteries will last the night, just barely.
[machine] I can hear the generator from here, it wants oil.
[void] Don't look too long at the dark between the stars.
[void] Something down in the deep is listening, but not to you.
[age0] The old spirits still walk these hills, whatever the young ones say.
[age3] Your scanners won't find me, so don't bother running them.
[knowsdead] {LOST} would have liked you, I think, {OTHER_nameDef}.
[knowsdead] I met {LOST} once, on a long road, a long time ago.
[knowsdead] You stand the way {LOST} used to, {OTHER_nameDef}.
[ennu] A house is known by its door, and I've knocked on a great many.
[ennu] I only want what any traveler wants, a roof and a little talk.
[ennu,first] I don't believe I've ever slept under this roof before.
[ennu,remembers] I've been here before, though you won't remember me.
[ennu,rememberskind] You kept a warm bed for me last time, I haven't forgotten.
[ennu,rememberscold] Last time I slept by your wall, and the wall was kinder.
[ennu,remembersharm] I still have the bruise from my last visit here.
Tell {OTHER_nameDef} that was the best meal I've had in an age.
My thanks to {OTHER_nameDef}, who cooks like someone who means it.
{OTHER_nameDef} has good hands, and I'll remember them.
That stew was {OTHER_nameDef}'s, wasn't it, I could tell.
[hearth] Give {OTHER_nameDef} my blessing, for the bowl and the bread.
[harvest] {OTHER_nameDef} knows what grain is for, tell them I said so.
That's not right, something's coming.
I've got a strange feeling about today.
Did anyone else see that, or is it just me?
My grandmother would have called that a sign.
[birds] The birds are all leaving, look at them go.
[birds] Every bird on the land took off at once.
[birds] Not a single bird left in the trees.
[calm] The wind's just stopped dead.
[calm] It's too quiet, even the grass isn't moving.
[calm] I can't hear a single leaf.
[candle] That lamp keeps going out, and there's no draft.
[candle] Third time I've lit that, it won't stay lit.
[candle] The flame just died, like someone pinched it.
[restless] The animals won't settle today.
[restless] They're all looking the same way, what do they see.
[restless] Something has the beasts spooked.
[storm] Feels like a storm, but there's no cloud.
[dead] My grandmother used to say this meant someone was crossing over.
[wild] The woods are listening, I swear it.
[hearth] Somewhere close by, someone is baking bread, but nobody is.
[drift] Every leaf on the ground is blowing the same way, and there's no wind.
[drift] Look at the seeds, they're all drifting toward one spot.
[animahum] Can you hear the tree humming, even from in here?
[animahum] The old tree is singing to itself tonight.
[dryadsstill] The dryads have all stopped dead, and they're facing the same way.
[dryadsstill] Why have the dryads gone so still?
[shadow] Something with wings just crossed the sun, and it was enormous.
[shadow] Did you feel that wind, and see the shadow go over?
[steam] The ground is breathing steam, like something's asleep under it.
[steam] That steam is warm as breath, I don't like it.
[rumble] The rock just groaned over our heads.
[rumble] That wasn't the rock settling, something down there moved.
[fairyring] Mushrooms in a perfect ring, and they weren't there yesterday.
[fairyring] Don't step inside that ring, my mother always said.
[earth] It smells like rain on earth, but nothing's wet.
[earth] Can you smell that, like a forest floor after a storm?
[threads] There are white threads all over the floor in there.
[threads] Something has been growing across that floor overnight.
[flicker] The lights are blinking like someone's tapping out a message.
[flicker] Short, long, short, those lights are doing it on purpose.
[static] The console is hissing, and I swear it laughed just now.
[static] There's breathing in that static, listen.
[unpowered] That light's on, and there's no power to it at all.
[unpowered] Who switched that lamp on, it isn't even connected?
[vastshadow] That shadow is far too big for any cloud I can see.
[vastshadow] Something passed between us and the sun, and there's nothing up there.
[star] That star is moving, and the wrong way.
[star] Look, one star is crossing the sky against all the others.
[frostwriting] The frost by the wall has made letters, or near enough.
[frostwriting] That frost looks like writing, but in no hand I know.
[silence] Did everything just go quiet, or is it me?
[silence] Not a sound anywhere, not even the wind.
[whitefigure] There's someone tall and white out at the edge of the dark.
[whitefigure] I saw a figure out there, and now it's gone.
[dark] That corner is too dark, the lamp should reach it.
[dark] The light just stops, right there, like a wall.
[whisper] Did someone just say my name, so kindly?
[whisper] There was a voice, so reasonable, telling me it's all right to stop.
[croak] Do you feel that croaking in your chest, from the wet ground?
[croak] Something old is singing down in the water, rain's coming.
[stillsun] The sun hasn't moved, look at the shadows.
[stillsun] My shadow hasn't shifted in an hour, I swear it.
[heathaze] The air's shimmering over the fields like a forge.
[heathaze] Look at the heat coming off the ground, it's wavering.
[bigmoon] The moon's never been that big, it's right over us.
[bigmoon] You could read by that moon tonight.
[glint] Something gold, just there, and gone when I turned.
[glint] I keep seeing a glint of gold out of the corner of my eye.
[beetle] A little gold beetle just walked right across the table.
[beetle] Did you see that beetle, it looked like it was made of gold?
[coin] A gold coin, right at my feet, and nobody dropped it.
[coin] Whose coin is this, it wasn't here a moment ago.
[rising] It has a face, there in the wood, and it's looking at us.
[rising] The roots came up out of the ground and stood up.
[fullmoon] Under a full moon like this, I'd believe anything.
[darkmoon] No moon tonight, and that's when strange things walk.
[halfmoon] Half a moon, half a warning, my grandmother said.
I dreamed someone was standing at the gate, waiting for it to open, and the light was behind them.
I dreamed every door in the colony was open, and a voice was counting them.
I dreamed I was asked a question at the gate, and I couldn't remember the answer when I woke.
[storm] I dreamed of a man made of thunder sitting on the roof, waiting.
[harvest] I dreamed the fields were gold to the horizon, and someone was walking through them.
[hunt] I dreamed a wolf bigger than a horse lay down by the fire and watched me.
[healing] I dreamed a woman in white washed my hands, and the water ran clear.
[war] I dreamed of a banner on the hill, red, and no army under it.
[craft] I dreamed I heard a hammer all night, and the anvil sang.
[way] I dreamed of a road that led to our gate from every direction at once.
[dead] I dreamed of a lantern crossing the river, and it stopped to look at me.
[night] I dreamed the moon came down and stood in the yard.
[hearth] I dreamed an old woman sat at our fire and asked for a bowl.
[wild] I dreamed of a white stag in the dining hall, eating from the table.
[waters] I dreamed the well overflowed, and the water was warm.
[machine] I dreamed the walls were humming, and the hum was a voice.
[void] I dreamed of a hole in the sky shaped like an eye.
[bellwether] I dreamed of a white beast with one horn, grazing by the well and looking at me.
[ennu] I dreamed someone knocked at the gate all night, patiently, and I didn't get up.
[mog] I dreamed a gray cat sat on my chest and stared until I woke.
[selene] I dreamed the moon came down to the yard and looked at everything we did today.
[fullmoon] I dreamed under a full moon, and everything in the dream was true.
{OTHER_nameDef}, I had the strangest dream, and I think you had it too.
You dreamed it too, didn't you, {OTHER_nameDef}, the gate.
Tell me you didn't dream what I dreamed, {OTHER_nameDef}.
Two of us, the same dream, that means something.
[wild] You saw the stag too, {OTHER_nameDef}, I can see it in your face.
[storm] You heard the thunder man too, {OTHER_nameDef}, didn't you.
[dead] The lantern, {OTHER_nameDef}, you saw the lantern too.
[hearth] The old woman by the fire, {OTHER_nameDef}, you saw her too.
[bellwether] The white beast with one horn, {OTHER_nameDef}, you dreamed it too.
[mog] The gray cat, {OTHER_nameDef}, it sat on you too, didn't it?
[selene] The moon in the yard, {OTHER_nameDef}, you saw it as well.
That's an answer if ever I saw one.
Somebody up there is listening to us.
Did you see the sky just now, that was for us.
[rain] Rain, right on time, thanks to {GOD}.
[rain] Feel that, {GOD} heard us.
[rain] Rain for the fields, I told you we'd be heard.
[thunder,pleased] Thunder on a clear day, that's {GOD} laughing.
[thunder,angered] That's {GOD}, and not pleased with us either.
[thunder] Did you hear that, that was meant for us.
[eclipse] The sun's gone dark, we've angered {GOD}.
[eclipse] Look at the sun, something's very wrong.
[aurora] Look at the sky, {GOD} is pleased with us tonight.
[aurora] Lights across the whole sky, for us.
[believed] See, I told you {GOD} would hear us.
[believed,rain] Say what you like, that rain came from {GOD}.
[believed,eclipse] Laugh all you want, but that's {GOD}'s doing.
[cold] This cold came down like a slammed door.
[cold] That's no ordinary frost, it's meant.
[snow] Snow, soft and right on time, like a blessing.
[snow] Look at it fall, as if someone is shaking out a blanket.
[heat] It's like being stared at, this heat.
[heat] Too much sun, as if someone forgot to stop giving it.
[clear] Not a cloud anywhere, it'll be a long good day.
[clear] A sky like this is a gift, whoever it's from.
[sleepless] Nobody slept, and the moon watched us all night.
[sleepless] Bad dreams in every bed, and the moon so bright.
[eclipse] Something just stepped in front of the sun.
This is the place, right here.
I still come out here sometimes, just to stand where it happened.
Nobody walks across this spot without slowing down.
I remember it like it was this morning.
[walking] This is where {GOD} stood, as close as you are to me.
[felt] Some say {GOD} stood right here, and I believe them.
[believed] My grandchildren will hear that {GOD} came here.
[blessing] Something good was left here once, and it still feels good.
[wrath] The ground still remembers how angry it was.
[reveal] I never got to say goodbye properly, not to a god.
[depart] I watched the stranger go from right here.
[wild] The flowers here never quite die back.
[waters] The spring hasn't run dry once since.
So this is the place they talk about on the road.
Is it true what they say happened here?
I've heard about this spot three towns away.
[walking] They say {GOD} came to this very place.
[felt] Some say {GOD} walked here, is that so?
[believed] My people say {GOD} came here once.
[wrath] Best not to linger where a god was angry.
Remember the night the stranger came, {OTHER_nameDef}?
I still think about what happened out by the gate, {OTHER_nameDef}.
Do you ever think about it, {OTHER_nameDef}, the god?
[walking] Imagine, {OTHER_nameDef}, {GOD} ate at this table.
[felt] I still say it was {GOD}, {OTHER_nameDef}, whatever you think.
[believed] My mother would say that was {GOD}'s doing, {OTHER_nameDef}.
[wrath] We were lucky, {OTHER_nameDef}, it could have been much worse.
[blessing] We've had good luck ever since, {OTHER_nameDef}, haven't we.
That's no ordinary {KIND}, look at it.
Nobody touch that {KIND}, I mean it.
I've never seen a {KIND} glow like that.
It looked right at me, the {KIND}.
[large] It walks like it owns the land.
[small] That {KIND} has been following someone all day.
[chosen] This {KIND} won't leave my side, and I don't mind.
[chosen] I think it picked me, the {KIND}.
[wild] The whole wood went quiet when it came out.
[hunt] Even the hunters lowered their bows.
[dead] A {KIND} like that only comes when someone is remembered.
[bellwether] The {BEAST} hasn't so much as looked at a fence.
[bellwether] Look at the others hanging back behind it, like pilgrims.
[bellwether] The grass is greener everywhere the {BEAST} grazed.
[mog] That {BEAST} has picked her person, and it isn't you.
[mog] The cats all follow her about like courtiers.
[mog] She sleeps in the warmest spot in the colony, every time.
I sat with the {BEAST} a while, and it let me.
It's so quiet near the {BEAST}, you can hear yourself think.
I don't know what I expected, but I feel better.
[horn] I touched its horn, and it was warm.
[horn] It put its head right down so I could reach.
[grief] It's lighter, somehow, the thing I've been carrying.
[grief] I cried a bit out there, and then I didn't need to.
[fear] I'm not afraid of it anymore, whatever it was.
[fear] Funny, my hands have stopped shaking.
[passion] I can't stop thinking about something I want to try.
[passion] I know what I want to be good at now.
Something's different in me since the stranger left.
I feel like I've been handed something, and I don't know what.
The way it looked at me, I can't stop thinking about it.
[spell] There's a scroll by my bed, and I didn't put it there.
[class] Something woke up in me, something I can't explain.
[passion] I've never wanted to work at anything so much.
[trait] I don't feel like myself, but I feel like more of myself.
[favour] I've got an idea, a real one, and it won't wait.
I dreamed the moon was looking in at my window, and I couldn't look away.
I dreamed my whole day over again, slowly, with the moon watching.
I dreamed someone pale held up a mirror, and my day was in it.
[good] I dreamed the one I helped today was laughing, and so was I.
[good] I dreamed of warm hands and a quiet house, and woke rested.
[good,fullmoon] I dreamed in moonlight so bright I could see every good thing I'd ever done.
[bad] I dreamed what I did today was done to me, again and again.
[bad] I dreamed of a cold room and a face I'd hurt, watching me.
[bad,fullmoon] I dreamed the full moon turned to look at me, and it knew.
Something happened in the night, {OTHER_nameDef}, and I can't explain it.
Did you see the moon last night, {OTHER_nameDef}?
I've been thinking about yesterday all morning, {OTHER_nameDef}.
[found] There was something by my bed this morning, {OTHER_nameDef}, and nobody left it.
[gooddream] I had the best dream, {OTHER_nameDef}, and I don't want to lose it.
[healed] My wound's half gone overnight, {OTHER_nameDef}, look.
[nightmare] I didn't sleep, {OTHER_nameDef}, and I don't want to talk about why.
[frost] Frost all round my window, {OTHER_nameDef}, and nowhere else.
[animalback] An animal stood at my door half the night, {OTHER_nameDef}, just looking.
[fullmoon] The moon was full last night, {OTHER_nameDef}, and I think it saw everything.
It wants me to follow it, I'm sure of it.
The {KIND} keeps looking back at me, so I'll go.
All right, I'm coming, show me.
I think I'm meant to go with it.
[wild] Lead on, then, I'm right behind you.
Do you still think about {LABEL}?
I dreamed about {LABEL} again last night.
I walked past where it happened, and I slowed down without meaning to.
[first] I never told anyone how scared I was, with {LABEL}.
Somebody asked me about {LABEL} today, and I didn't know what to say.
Was it really a god, do you think, {LABEL}?

warm.li: I'm glad it was you beside me when we saw {LABEL}.

blunt.li: I still don't know what to make of {LABEL}, and I've tried.

gloomy.li: Ever since {LABEL}, I feel like something is watching us.

cold.li: We should write down what we saw of {LABEL}, before we forget it.

plain.li: Every day, some days more than others.
I keep remembering how quiet everything went.
I've stopped trying to explain it to the others.
[first] I thought I was the only one who couldn't stop thinking about it.
The light, I remember the light most of all.
Some days I'm sure, some days I'm not sure at all.

warm.li: I'm glad I wasn't alone for it.

blunt.li: It happened, and that's all I know.

cheerful.li: Best thing that ever happened to this place, if you ask me.

gloomy.li: I hope it never comes back, to be honest.

cold.li: I've thought about it, and I still can't account for it.

plain.li: Whatever it was, we saw it together.
Let's not tell it too often, or it'll stop being true.
If it ever comes again, I'll know it this time.
I'll light a candle for it tonight, just in case.
